targets_rows.description: The rows this edit must hold for, by their `[#id]` marks — at least two, and all inside ONE critique cluster where the CRITIQUE panel lists clusters.
targets_rows.title: Targets Rows

pipeline_overlay.description: Nested {node: {param: value}} — scalar backend tunables and `output_schema_descriptions.<path>` prose, each a param under ITS NODE, NEVER a top-level key beside the nodes. Scalar params (temperature, tokens, effort) are a last resort: at most one, and only where a panel or a runtime failure points there.
pipeline_overlay.title: Pipeline Overlay

prompt_fields_updates.description: Per prompt node, its prompt fields: {node: {field: new full text}}.
prompt_fields_updates.title: Prompt Fields Updates

shots.description: Per prompt node, the shots it runs with: demo-pool ids from the DEMO POOL panel, in order. Replaces that node's list; omit a node to keep it.
shots.title: Shots

field.description: A citable panel named in the prompt, or stall_exploration.
field.title: Field

sample_ids.description: The rows this cluster spans, by the `[#id]` marks in the panels — at least two. Two rows that fail for different reasons are two clusters, never one.
sample_ids.title: Sample Ids

mechanism.description: The ONE root cause, as a short label naming the cognitive move that fails.
mechanism.title: Mechanism

claim.description: WHY these rows land wrong, in your own words: the step that breaks and what was said against the truth. General over the cluster, never one row's procedure.
claim.title: Claim

failure_highlights.description: One per DISTINCT failure cluster, ≤3, largest first.
failure_highlights.title: Failure Highlights

priority_fix.description: The single strongest steer, as `<axis>: <concrete change>`. The axis leads, before the colon, named VERBATIM from the vocabulary this node's prompt states. One you invent is dropped downstream and takes the steer's axis menu with it, so the next round reads a fix naming no lever it can pull.
priority_fix.title: Priority Fix

suggested_axes.description: ≤4 short axis names. Each item ≤40 chars (downstream truncates).
suggested_axes.title: Suggested Axes

reason.description: 1-2 sentences naming the cause and what the operator must fix.
reason.title: Reason

unlock_schema_field_rename.description: Let the fork's L1 rename a field on the inner l1_generate's output schema (it can only describe fields today). Set ONLY when the panels show the search stalling on what a field is FOR rather than on what it says — a field whose name misdescribes its content. Default false.
unlock_schema_field_rename.title: Unlock Schema Field Rename

reason.description: 1-2 sentences naming the cause and what the operator must fix.
reason.title: Reason

axis_targeted.description: The L1 axis the failure cluster routes to — a prompt field for a semantic failure, a param for a quantitative one. Name it on every fire; it is the anchor the lever is judged against, not a label for the lever.
axis_targeted.title: Axis Targeted

l1_layout.description: Where in the READING node's own prompt each evidence panel is rendered. A slot is a position in that prompt, never the target-prompt field the evidence is about: the reader gets every placed panel whichever slot holds it. Keyed by SLOT — the four properties are the only slots there are — each listing the panels to place there: a listed panel MOVES to that slot, an omitted one stays where it is, and a panel is only ever in one place. Legal panels: answer_distribution, axis_memory, block_pool, budget_state, confounds, critique, demo_pool, detectable_move, diagnostics, escalation_panel, failing_samples, inner_narratives, l1_wounds, measurand, mutation_memory, pipeline_param_catalogue, plan, rendered_prompt, sample_transcripts, task_context.
l1_layout.title: L1 Layout

l1_overrides.description: Optional runtime knobs; only 'temperature' and 'n_variants' are read.
l1_overrides.title: L1 Overrides

rationale.description: Why this fire, in 1-2 sentences: the failure cluster you are attacking and the named data point behind it — a sample id, a count, a yield number. Required on every fire, including one that pulls no lever; a lever with no diagnosis behind it cannot be told from a guess.
rationale.title: Rationale

reason.description: 1-2 sentences naming the cause and what the operator must fix.
reason.title: Reason

unlock_schema_field_rename.description: Let the fork's L1 rename a field on the inner l1_generate's output schema (it can only describe fields today). Set ONLY when the panels show the search stalling on what a field is FOR rather than on what it says — a field whose name misdescribes its content. Default false.
unlock_schema_field_rename.title: Unlock Schema Field Rename

reason.description: 1-2 sentences naming the cause and what the operator must fix.
reason.title: Reason

plan.description: The strategy every later prompt reads until the next replan. Say what L2 and L1 should DO with the levers they hold — L2 moves which panels L1 sees and how wide it explores; L1 rewrites the target prompt's fields. A plan written in the solver's vocabulary instructs neither, and rides every downstream call regardless.
plan.title: Plan
